title: Unit Event — The Legend Still Vivid

meta.Outline: Thanks to their experience of going camping together, VBS has learned the importance of having a shared vision when they sing. Kohane asks Taiga if there's a way for them to establish a shared vision of RAD WEEKEND without any footage of the event to go off of.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho? You're not with Ichika and the others today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, they're all busy with committee stuff today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
That's actually sort of nice since it's been a little while since we last had lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?
We can have a special classroom lunch today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As in just having lunch in class?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's special because you're here, Shiho!
Let's put our desks together and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, your Salisbury steaks look so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
She's right!
Are these homemade, not frozen...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh... Yeah...
My mom makes these pretty often.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She apparently wants to make sure I have plenty to eat since I'm always busy with the band and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Your mom sounds like such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, how's practice been going for you two lately?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm kinda curious as to what kind of stuff you guys all practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Take the Fan Festival for example. Remember how you met up with Kohane's group to practice singing, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika even talked about how that practice really opened her eyes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I'm wondering if there are any good drills or tips you could tell me about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Good drills...?
Hmm... Do you have any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My team is usually at its best when we have the same image or ideas in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. We started working on this song and began wondering how we could capture the “serenity of a forest” so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And it turned out that one of our teammates had never been to an actual forest before, which sort of kept us from syncing right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So we decided to go camping in a forest to fix that. As a result, we were able to sing this song really well because we all had the same image in our heads.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
That is a pretty good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We watched a DVD of this famous band's concert together the other day and it really helped us get in sync.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That must've also been because it gave us such a clear picture of what we needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we usually work on dances while watching footage for a show as a reference and it always helps us get in sync!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like we all arrived at the same solution. Talk about a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It probably means having a clear picture of what you want to do or become is just that important.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What I want to become...?
That's easy! A great idol, just like Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's just you, Minori.
I was talking about what each of our groups are striving to become.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
You guys are trying to surpass that one event... RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean you watch videos of that event as a team?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... There aren't any videos out there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I tried asking An and the others a while back...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
There aren't any as far as I know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
No cameras were allowed during RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, there probably wouldn't be any videos left regardless.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Based on what Akito's told me...
Nobody there would've been taking pictures or videos.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, the whole place was nuts.
They were all probably too immersed or focused on the show to record anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since everybody has smartphones now, there's usually some kind of evidence out there showing that an event like that happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But that's not the case for this one.
It's part of why it's become such a legendary event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So there's no way for me to see what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It is...
But it also tells me that it was just that incredible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But...!
Not being able to see it just makes you want to see it more, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was really hoping to see what An and Shinonome experienced, but I guess there really isn't anything I can do about it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we're all busy after this, so let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
Do you think you'll make it to your practice with Taiga in time, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I should be okay as long as I leave within the next ten minutes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't you take a quick break since you still have time? I'm sure you're tired after singing so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget... I have a question for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You guys said that there aren't any videos, but isn't there anything left that can tell me what the actual show was like...? Photos, anything...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Photos? There might be some of the venue, but no cameras were allowed inside.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Still, why this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I was talking to Minori and another classmate today about how we all practice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
So that we all have the same mental image.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why I want to learn more about what RAD WEEKEND was really like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We already know how important it is to have the same picture in our minds, so it should certainly help us grow as a team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we've already told you everything we know...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, like which teams were there and their set lists... Also, we already lent you all the CDs that they had out at the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's on top of all of my dad and Uncle Taiga's stories, so I'm not really sure what's left...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it were any other event, we could just ask around at the live house where it took place...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But the venue for RAD WEEKEND closed ages ago and the owner's retired since.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it happened at this really old place called “COL”, and RAD WEEKEND became its final event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That might just leave...
The event's atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: From what I've heard, it was nothing like what anyone had experienced before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And there really isn't any way for either myself or Azusawa to fully comprehend that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I'd like to know more about that as well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean... I dunno...
How do you even describe it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same.
You can't really put it into words...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was just... Absolutely mind-blowing, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything we can do to learn more about what really happened during RAD WEEKEND?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Are you okay for time, Azusawa?
Don't you have to go practice with Taiga soon?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I completely forgot...!
Sorry, I need to go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Have fun!
I'll try asking around about RAD WEEKEND while you're gone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He should be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
There you are.
Sorry for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for meeting again with me today, Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What are we going to do today?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Well...
How about a little walk?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We took a walk last time, so...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Haha. That's true.
But we're not just walking around today.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I want you to take a good look at this city and all its people, and let it really sink in.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You mentioned that last time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How there's something you want everyone to “see through music.”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They say that about 80% of the information we take in comes from what we see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You can learn a lot from just people-watching, looking around the city, seeing all the colors and gauging how close or far away certain things are.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
But where does that leave our ears?
What can we learn from hearing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We can... Hear how people feel...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly.
That also includes how far away they are and which way they're facing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, our eyes still end up being more powerful than our ears. Which means there's only so much you can do with sound alone.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So the question becomes, “How do you make people see through music?”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah.
More than that depending on the situation.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, my point is that just singing isn't enough. I want you to at least take that away from this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hang on. Does this walk have anything to do with what happened back then...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That you'll have to figure out for yourself. I mean, you still have plenty of time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I didn't know there was an instrument shop here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We usually practice just over there too...
I guess I don't know this area as well as I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line:
Hey, Taiga, what's up?!
You even brought Kohane along.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
We're taking a walk.
I'm showing her around this area.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line:
Nice.
You're always welcome to sing here if you're ever free. Just let me know and I'll open up a slot for you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, could be good for a change.
I'll think about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Hehe. He's so popular around here.
So many people have called out to him already...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh, I remember you! We were in a lot of the same events when I was performing on my own...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, I need to stay focused.
Taiga probably won't like it if...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, he's still talking, so I guess it's okay for me to do the same.)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
What brings you here? Wait...
Are you with Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
So the rumors were true?
He's taken you under his wing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, he's just been giving me some advice and observing how I practice!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
That's still unbelievable!
This is Taiga we're talking about! A world-famous musician!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: You should've seen him during RAD WEEKEND. Amazing doesn't even begin to describe what happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see... I really envy you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I just wish I could've been there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone's told me all about how great RAD WEEKEND was, but there's no way for me to actually see for myself...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Plus, Ken went into retirement...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: But there should be a video of it somewhere. I remember seeing someone recording everything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I was told that no cameras were allowed.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: You're right, but there was definitely someone there taking a video. It was too dark to see who, but my guess is that they were staff or something.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you so much!
I-I'll try to see if I can find that video!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Yeah, good luck.
Actually, Taiga might know who.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks for waiting.
Hm? What's up...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you know where the video of RAD WEEKEND is?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Sorry, but nothing like that exists.
I made sure that no one brought any cameras into the venue.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you're saying that none of the staff took any videos?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. They have videos of other events, but not RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND was only meant for that day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Did that other girl see something by mistake...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (After finally getting a hold of what I thought was a good lead regarding RAD WEEKEND too...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You really want to know more about RAD WEEKEND that much?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An and Shinonome were actually there for RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But Aoyagi and I weren't, so we've had to piece everything together through stories and hearsay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our goal is to surpass RAD WEEKEND, but we're having a hard time getting a clear idea of how.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what if you told me more about what you saw from the stage? That might help me get a better picture of what happened...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Tell you...? I'm not that great at telling stories, so I wouldn't be able to do it justice.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Not only that, if stories alone could tell you what that event was like, you'd already have a good idea by now, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even so, I want to know more...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to learn as much as I can about RAD WEEKEND if I'm going to try and surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So please, anything you can teach me will be appreciated! Can't you tell me more about what you saw, sang and felt...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: This might be a case of a picture actually being worth a thousand words...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I can't help you with the video, but I can at least show you where it happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wh-Where it happened...?
You mean the live house where RAD WEEKEND took place?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But I heard that it closed right after and the owner retired...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You mean that granny? She's doing just fine. You just gotta know how to get a hold of her, so I'll let you know when I do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm gonna get to see the venue where RAD WEEKEND actually happened...!!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Anyway, enough about RAD WEEKEND.
Let's get back to actually practicing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga's gonna show you where RAD WEEKEND happened?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! He said he'll let me know when he gets a hold of the owner!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's going out of his way to find the owner? We'll need to thank him later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, we will...
Still, I never thought I'd get to see that place again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, that place had a huge effect on me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If RAD WEEKEND didn't happen there, I probably wouldn't be talking to you right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which means it's where everything began.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Can we tag along and see it too?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's where this legendary event happened, right?! I really wanna see it and I promise not to be a bother!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Len...
You don't have to take him if it poses too much of a challenge.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, it's where An and Akito's feelings were born, right? And those feelings are why this SEKAI is here at all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't you want to know more about how everything began?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we let them know once we get there? They should be able to get in some quick peeks while staying out of Uncle Taiga's sight.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You should be able to poke your heads out while our phones are in our pockets.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, you both gotta be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll let you know when we get there, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great, we'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, I switched the sign to “Open”!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
Oh, I should let you know now that I'm gonna be busy in the afternoon next Saturday.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure, no problem. Are you guys having practice then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we're gonna go to COL... I mean, see where RAD WEEKEND happened.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
What?
But that place closed ages ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We know, but Uncle Taiga said he's gonna get a hold of the owner and show us around!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and Toya haven't seen it yet, so we're really excited about going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was just as surprised.
I didn't expect him to go out of his way to do something like this for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm worried about him “getting a hold of” the owner... She's pretty old now, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, she turned eighty this year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
E-Eighty?!
Geez, now I feel worse about asking him to do this...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I'm sure she can handle him.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Still...
He's really doing this, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
No, just reminiscing.
Have fun, alright?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (The guy who was completely obsessed with becoming the greatest ever is going out of his way to do this.)
If this place really does end up producing the best singer in the world...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (He doesn't want to let her down.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I didn't think I'd ever get a chance to do this...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (But I think it's time I handed “that” to them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? We agreed to meet at eleven, right? But we're all here thirty minutes early...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know why!
We were all looking forward to today so much that we couldn't help but wake up early! Even Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we're not little kids and this isn't some field trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, she might not be far off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Quiet, you...
The point is that I never thought I'd get to see this place again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They must've really been looking forward to this day if they're this openly anxious about it.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm finally getting a chance to see a part of the reason why An and Shinonome want to surpass RAD WEEKEND as much as they do...!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys are early.
We weren't supposed to meet for a while, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course we're here early!
Two of us at least never thought we'd ever get to see COL again!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for creating this incredible opportunity for us today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We definitely wouldn't have been able to do anything like this on our own.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Heh. I'm glad you're happy, but this is about all I can show you guys at this point...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The owner's waiting for us there, so let's start making our way over.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Here it is.
The basement for this building's COL.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, talk about a blast from the past... I totally remember lining up here to get in, and how the line spilled out onto the street...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and three years have passed since...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: From the outside, it looks like any of the other dives you can find around here.
Just what exactly are you calling a dive...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, Granny.
See? As happy and healthy as ever, right?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'm the owner of this place, not your “Granny”. Thirty years and you still refuse to learn any manners...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this person really the owner, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's her. She used to own and operate a bunch of live houses around here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad and Uncle Taiga have known her since they were our age.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
That's so cool.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Anyway, long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, if it isn't An.
It's nice to see that the girl with a chip on her shoulder's grown up so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Heehee!
It's nice to see you too!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Ah, you must be the one who's been aching to see my dive.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, hello...!
My name is Kohane Azusawa. I'm on the same team as An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We heard that you closed this place a long time ago, so thank you for being so kind as to show us around like this...!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
I've been coming here from time to time to keep it clean.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Well, I'm going to have to hand this place over to someone at some point... Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'm sure actually being here will help you remember that night better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That night... Is she referring to RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably.
Especially since this is where RAD WEEKEND happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was probably the event she was looking for to cap off the history of this place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So RAD WEEKEND meant a lot to the owner of this venue as well...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's really where RAD WEEKEND happened...
I have to absorb as much as I can...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our eyes haven't adjusted yet since it's so bright out today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just don't slip and fall, alright?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
He's right.
We need to watch where we walk.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Give me a second to turn on the floodlights.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is where RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's so much smaller than I remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably because we were kids.
I'm guessing we were both a lot shorter back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That means we've grown up a lot since.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, the stage is literally right in front of us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
This is really the venue for RAD WEEKEND?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. We're here.
Sorry, we just couldn't wait.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, they'll see you if you keep jumping out like that. Wait until we give you the signal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Okay, I'm sorry...
I'll be careful from now on.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We promise to stay hidden, so please let us see.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose you'll stay out of sight as long as you stay in Azusawa's pocket.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll try to position myself so that you both can get a good look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a place that everybody in Vivid Street talks so highly about, so I was expecting it to be more like a big concert hall...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The distance between the stage and the floor felt no different from any other live house.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
I was also expecting to see something a little more extravagant.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your group should've had free reign in terms of choosing a venue, Taiga, so why here...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We wanted to perform here because we'd been singing here forever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Granny, what's it like backstage here?

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
